newsitem.title: LEBANON: World Bank grants Lebanon $31 mln for agriculture.
newsitem.headline: World Bank grants Lebanon $31 mln for agriculture.

text.p: The World Bank granted Lebanon on Thursday $31 million for agricultural development, the government's reconstruction agency said.
The Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) said the loan would be used to rehabilitate the infrastructure of 5,600 hectares (13,836 acres) of agricultural land.
It would also be used in constructing 300 km (186.3 miles) of roads linking rural areas together.
The Council did not give details of the loan -- signed by World Bank Middle East Manager Inder Sud and CDR President Nabil al-Jisr.
"Some 9,600 families or 75,000 people will benefit from this project," the CDR said in a statement.
World Bank loans to Lebanon since 1992 total $551 million.
